items.computation: The letter states the appointment date and time directly: Monday, 14.12.2026 at 16:15. No calculation needed, the date is explicit.

items.title: Cancel appointment (if unable to attend) at least two business days in advance
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. Counting backward in Werktage (business days, i.e. Mon-Sat excluding Sundays and public holidays, per NW holiday calendar - no holidays fall in this period): Sunday 13.12 is not a Werktag and is skipped; Saturday 12.12.2026 is the 1st Werktag before the appointment; Friday 11.12.2026 is the 2nd Werktag before the appointment. So the latest day a cancellation can be made to satisfy 'at least two Werktage vorher' is Friday, 11.12.2026. This obligation only arises if the patient cannot attend ('Wenn Sie verhindert sind').
